source: // A non-virtual class that extends a specialization of a parameterized
// virtual class must implement its pure virtual method (8.21).
pure virtual function void f(T t);

explanation.en: A conforming compiler rejects derived, which leaves the pure virtual f of a parameterized base unimplemented. Verilator 5.052 builds and runs it, while it rejects the same omission when base has no parameters.
explanation.ja: parameter付きの基底のpure virtualであるfを実装しないderivedは、規格に従うcompilerなら拒否する。Verilator 5.052はこれをbuildして実行する。一方、基底にparameterがない場合の同じ欠落は拒否する。

source: // The default of VISITOR depends on the earlier type parameter STRUCTURE
// (6.20.1), as in a visitor adapter that only overrides STRUCTURE.
pure virtual function void visit(NODE node);
pure virtual function void accept(STRUCTURE s, VISITOR v);
virtual function void accept(STRUCTURE s, VISITOR v);

explanation.en: adapter#(other_node) has VISITOR = visitor#(other_node), so the design is legal and prints "visited". Verilator 5.052 rejects it at the default of VISITOR in adapter ("Can't find typedef/interface: 'STRUCTURE'").
explanation.ja: adapter#(other_node)のVISITORはvisitor#(other_node)となるので、このdesignは正しく、"visited"を表示する。Verilator 5.052はadapterのVISITORの既定値でこれを拒否する（"Can't find typedef/interface: 'STRUCTURE'"）。

source: // An enumerated type may have any integral base type (6.19); name() returns
// the name of the current value (6.19.5.6).

explanation.en: The design is legal and prints B. Verilator 5.052 reports name() on an enum wider than 64 bits as unsupported.
explanation.ja: このdesignは正しく、Bを表示する。Verilator 5.052は、64 bitより広いenumのname()を未対応と報告する。

source: // kill() terminates the process and the processes it spawned with fork
// (9.7); the child below must never write late.

explanation.en: A conforming simulator terminates the child with its parent and exits normally. Verilator 5.052 lets the child of the killed process run, so the check reaches $fatal.
explanation.ja: 規格に従うsimulatorは、親とともに子processも止め、正常に終わる。Verilator 5.052はkillしたprocessの子processを動かし続けるため、確認が$fatalに達する。

source: // A process blocked on @m is released by ->m (15.5.1), even when the
// triggering process then waits on m again in the same time slice.
if (!early) $fatal(1, "the waiter blocked before the trigger was not released");

explanation.en: A conforming simulator releases the first waiter at time 2. Verilator 5.052 does not when the event is a class member and the triggering process waits on it again in the same time slice; the same pattern on a module-level event is released.
explanation.ja: 規格に従うsimulatorは、時刻2で最初に待っていたprocessを解放する。Verilator 5.052は、eventがclassのmemberで、起動したprocessが同じtime sliceで再び待つと解放しない。moduleのeventでの同じ形は解放する。

source: // ->m releases the processes waiting on m (15.5.1); assigning another event to
// m afterwards (15.5.5) does not undo that release.
if (!woke) $fatal(1, "the waiter was not released by ->m");

explanation.en: A conforming simulator releases the waiter that ->m triggered before the assignment. Verilator 5.052 leaves it waiting, so the check reaches $fatal.
explanation.ja: 規格に従うsimulatorは、代入の前に->mが起動した待ちのprocessを解放する。Verilator 5.052は待たせたままにするため、確認が$fatalに達する。

source: // Same-name parameterized classes of two packages are different types
// (26.3, 8.25), so $cast from one to the other fails (8.16).
class box #(type T = int) extends root;
class box #(type T = int) extends root;
if ($cast(b, r)) $fatal(1, "a first_pkg::box was cast to second_pkg::box");

explanation.en: A conforming simulator rejects the cast and prints "cast rejected". Verilator 5.052 lets the cast succeed between the parameterized classes, so the check reaches $fatal; the same classes without parameters are rejected.
explanation.ja: 規格に従うsimulatorはcastを拒否し、"cast rejected"を表示する。Verilator 5.052はparameter付きのclassどうしのcastを通すため、確認が$fatalに達する。parameterのない同じclassでは拒否する。

source: // A process blocked on m before another event is assigned to m shall never
// unblock (15.5.5.1); the merge affects only later event controls.
if (new_wakes != 1) $fatal(1, "the waiter armed after the merge was not released");
if (old_wakes != 0) $fatal(1, "the waiter blocked before the merge was released");

explanation.en: A conforming simulator releases only the waiter armed after the assignment and prints "old waiter stays blocked". Verilator 5.052 also releases the waiter that was blocked before the assignment, so the check reaches $fatal; it does not support the same assignment between module-level events in this context.
explanation.ja: 規格に従うsimulatorは代入の後に待ち始めたprocessだけを起こし、"old waiter stays blocked"を表示する。Verilator 5.052は代入の前から待っていたprocessも起こすため、確認が$fatalに達する。moduleのeventどうしの同じ代入は、この文脈では対応していない。

source: // $finish makes the simulator exit (20.2), so the caller of a task that
// executes $finish does not resume; the final procedure still runs (9.2.3).

explanation.en: A conforming simulator exits at $finish, so the caller never sets resumed and the final procedure passes. Verilator 5.052 lets the caller run on after $finish, so the final check reaches $fatal; the same happens with $finish directly in the initial procedure.
explanation.ja: 規格に従うsimulatorは$finishで終わるので、呼出し元はresumedを設定せず、final procedureは通る。Verilator 5.052は$finishの後も呼出し元を続けるため、finalでの確認が$fatalに達する。initial procedureで直接$finishを呼んでも同じである。

source: // A randomize() with clause adds its constraints to the class constraints
// (18.7), and size() constrains the size of a rand queue (18.5.7.1).
if (!h.randomize() with { q.size() == 3; }) $fatal(1, "a satisfiable randomize failed");
if (h.q.size() != 3) $fatal(1, "the inline size constraint was not applied");

explanation.en: A conforming simulator makes the queue three elements long and prints "size 3". Verilator 5.052 returns success with an empty queue when the class also constrains the size, so the check reaches $fatal; without the class constraint the inline size is applied.
explanation.ja: 規格に従うsimulatorはqueueを3要素にし、"size 3"を表示する。Verilator 5.052は、classも大きさを制約していると空のqueueのまま成功を返すため、確認が$fatalに達する。classの制約がなければinlineの大きさは反映される。

source: // A subclass inherits the constraints of its base (18.5.2), so a size that
// the base forbids makes randomize() fail and return 0 (18.6.1).

explanation.en: A conforming simulator finds the constraints infeasible, so randomize() returns 0 and the module prints "contradiction rejected". Verilator 5.052 returns 1 when the base class is in a package, so the check reaches $fatal; with the base class outside a package it returns 0.
explanation.ja: 規格に従うsimulatorは制約を満たせないと判断し、randomize()は0を返して"contradiction rejected"を表示する。Verilator 5.052はbase classがpackageにあると1を返すため、確認が$fatalに達する。base classがpackageの外なら0を返す。

source: // If randomize() fails, post_randomize() is not called (18.6.3).
if (p.post_calls != 0) $fatal(1, "post_randomize ran after a failed randomize");

explanation.en: A conforming simulator fails the randomization without calling post_randomize and prints "post_randomize skipped". Verilator 5.052 returns 0 but calls post_randomize, so the check reaches $fatal.
explanation.ja: 規格に従うsimulatorはpost_randomizeを呼ばずに乱数化を失敗させ、"post_randomize skipped"を表示する。Verilator 5.052は0を返すがpost_randomizeを呼ぶため、確認が$fatalに達する。

note.en: The pinned phase hopper kills the phase process (m_phase_proc) at cleanup, and the phase tasks run in processes that it spawned with fork; 1800-2023 9.7 makes kill() terminate those subprocesses too. Verilator leaves them running, as the reproducer shows.

note.en: 10.1.1.2.2 wakes waiters only when wakeup is set and otherwise only returns the event to its off state; the pinned reset replaces the internal event and clears the waiter count, so the waiting processes are stranded and a fresh trigger cannot release them.
note.ja: 10.1.1.2.2はwakeupが指定されたときだけ待っているprocessを起こし、それ以外はeventをoff状態へ戻すだけとする。固定版のresetは内部のeventを差し替えて待ち数を0にするため、待っているprocessは取り残され、新しいtriggerでも解放されない。

readings.en: callback_mode(0) disables a callback, so a disabled event callback is skipped.
readings.ja: callback_mode(0)はcallbackを無効にするので、無効にしたeventのcallbackは呼ばれない。

readings.en: 10.2 calls an attached callback each time the event is triggered, without regard to its mode; the library calls every attached callback.
readings.ja: 10.2は、eventにつないだcallbackを、modeにかかわらずeventが起動されるたびに呼ぶとし、libraryはつないだcallbackをすべて呼ぶ。

note.en: 10.4.1 says an event pool contains begin, accept and end by default; the pinned uvm_event_pool is a plain string pool that creates entries only on get.

note.en: The pinned trigger executes ->m_event and wait_trigger waits with @m_event, as 10.1.1.2.4 and 10.1.2.2.4 need. When the triggering process waits on the same class-member event in the same time slice, Verilator does not release the process that was already waiting.
note.ja: 固定版のtriggerは->m_eventを実行し、wait_triggerは@m_eventで待つ。これは10.1.1.2.4と10.1.2.2.4が求めるとおりである。起動したprocessが同じtime sliceで同じclassのmemberのeventを待ち直すと、Verilatorは先に待っていたprocessを解放しない。

note.en: With wakeup set, the pinned reset executes ->m_event before it replaces the internal event, as 10.1.1.2.2 requires. Verilator does not release the waiting processes when the event variable is assigned in the same function, so the run stops at the watchdog.
note.ja: wakeupが指定されたとき、固定版のresetは10.1.1.2.2のとおり、内部のeventを差し替える前に->m_eventを実行する。Verilatorは、同じfunctionでevent変数へ代入すると待っているprocessを解放しないため、実行はwatchdogで止まる。

note.en: In a big-endian map the most-significant byte is at the lowest address (17.2.2.4); the pinned field access counts the skipped bus words from the least-significant end, so it selects the opposite address, and then reverses the bytes of the whole 64-bit data, which moves the byte out of the bus.
note.ja: big endianのmapでは最上位のbyteが最も低いaddressにある（17.2.2.4）。固定版のfieldのaccessは飛ばすbus wordを最下位の側から数えるため反対のaddressを選び、さらに64 bitのdata全体のbyteを入れ替えるため、byteがbusの外へ移る。

note.en: 18.5.5.16 makes a field individually accessible when it fits the bus and can be accessed without affecting other fields; with byte enables, a field in its own byte lane qualifies, but the pinned check, after confirming byte-enable support, still requires the neighbouring fields to start on another bus word, so the whole register is accessed.
note.ja: 18.5.5.16は、busに収まり、ほかのfieldに影響せずにaccessできるfieldを個別にaccess可能とする。byte enableがあれば自身のbyte laneにあるfieldはこれに当たるが、固定版の確認はbyte enableの対応を確かめた後も、隣のfieldが別のbus wordから始まることを求めるため、register全体をaccessする。

note.en: 18.5.5.16 makes a field individually accessible when it fits the bus and can be accessed without affecting other fields; with byte enables, a field in its own byte lane qualifies, but the pinned check, after confirming byte-enable support, still requires the neighbouring fields to start on another bus word, so the whole register is accessed.
note.ja: 18.5.5.16は、busに収まり、ほかのfieldに影響せずにaccessできるfieldを個別にaccess可能とする。byte enableがあれば自身のbyte laneにあるfieldはこれに当たるが、固定版の確認はbyte enableの対応を確かめた後も、隣のfieldが別のbus wordから始まることを求めるため、register全体をaccessする。

note.ja: 18.5.6.1と18.5.6.3は、fieldのpre_writeやpre_readが設定したaddress mapを使うと定める。固定版のregisterはfieldのhookを呼ぶ前にlocal mapとそのmap情報を決めて保持するため、accessは元のmapへ向かう。

readings.en: A back-door write mimics a physical write, and a physical write to a register whose only field is read-only changes nothing, so the whole stored word stays.
readings.ja: back doorでのwriteは物理的なwriteを模し、read-onlyのfieldしかないregisterへの物理的なwriteは何も変えないので、記憶したword全体がそのまま残る。

readings.en: Only the modeled field bits have a defined write effect; the library keeps the read-only field and writes back a value assembled from the fields, which changes bits no field models.
readings.ja: 書込みの効果が定まるのはmodelしたfieldのbitだけである。libraryはread-onlyのfieldを保ち、fieldから組み立てた値を書き戻すため、どのfieldもmodelしないbitが変わる。

note.en: 18.5.5.9 keeps read-only bits on a back-door write but does not say what happens to bits no field models; the library keeps the read-only field and changes the unmodeled bits.
note.ja: 18.5.5.9はback doorのwriteでread-onlyのbitを保つとするが、どのfieldもmodelしないbitがどうなるかは言っていない。libraryはread-onlyのfieldを保ち、modelしないbitを変える。

readings.en: The RO rights given when the memory is added to the map are an access restriction of that map, so get_access returns RO for the read-write memory.
readings.ja: memoryをmapに加えるときに与えたRO権限はそのmapのaccessの制限なので、read-writeのmemoryのget_accessはROを返す。

readings.en: 18.6.4.5 says rights are restricted only for a shared memory, so an unshared memory has no restriction and get_access returns its own policy; the library returns RW.
readings.ja: 18.6.4.5は権限の制限を共有memoryに限るので、共有しないmemoryには制限がなく、get_accessは自身のpolicyを返す。libraryはRWを返す。

note.en: 18.6.4.6 accounts for map restrictions while 18.6.4.5 limits restrictions to shared memories; for an unshared memory added with RO rights the library returns its own policy.
note.ja: 18.6.4.6はmapの制限を考慮するとし、18.6.4.5は制限を共有memoryに限る。RO権限で加えた共有しないmemoryについて、libraryは自身のpolicyを返す。

note.en: 18.6.4.15 returns the base offset of the specified location; the pinned get_offset ignores the location argument and returns the memory's base offset.
note.ja: 18.6.4.15は、指定した位置の基準offsetを返すと定める。固定版のget_offsetは位置の引数を無視し、memoryの基準offsetを返す。

note.en: 18.6.9.2 invokes the registered callbacks before post_write; the pinned memory calls post_write first and the callbacks afterwards.
note.ja: 18.6.9.2は、登録したcallbackをpost_writeより先に呼ぶと定める。固定版のmemoryはpost_writeを先に呼び、callbackを後で呼ぶ。

note.en: A pre_read callback may change the offset and the address map used for the access (18.11.2.4); the pinned memory resolves the local map and its map information before the callbacks and keeps them, so the access still goes to the original map.
note.ja: pre_readのcallbackは、accessに使うoffsetとaddress mapを変えてよい（18.11.2.4）。固定版のmemoryはcallbackの前にlocal mapとそのmap情報を決めて保持するため、accessは元のmapへ向かう。

note.en: 18.6.7.1 returns the parent's back door only when inherited is set and the memory has none of its own; the pinned get_backdoor stores the inherited back door as the memory's own, so a later query with inherited 0 returns it.
note.ja: 18.6.7.1は、inheritedを設定し、memory自身のback doorがないときだけ親のback doorを返すと定める。固定版のget_backdoorは継承したback doorをmemory自身のものとして保持するため、後でinherited 0で問い合わせてもそれを返す。

note.en: 18.2.4.5 makes the effective bus width the narrowest from the map to the root; the pinned map derives it from its translation, which returns 0, and falls back to its own width, so the child under a narrower root reports and transfers its own width.

note.en: UVM_BIG_ENDIAN places the most-significant bytes first in consecutive addresses (17.2.2.4); the pinned map already orders the bus words that way, and then reverses the bytes of the whole 64-bit data of each access, which moves a 2- or 4-byte bus word out of the bus width, so the adapter writes and the register reads 0.

note.en: The pinned adapters declare VISITOR = uvm_visitor#(STRUCTURE), as F.5.4.1 to F.5.6.1 do. With STRUCTURE overridden, the default must follow it (1800-2023 6.20.1), but Verilator types VISITOR as uvm_visitor#(uvm_component), built from the default of STRUCTURE. The same traversals with an explicit VISITOR match. Verilator rejects the reproducer, which has no UVM, outright: a different symptom of the same dependent default.
note.ja: 固定版のadapterは、F.5.4.1〜F.5.6.1と同じくVISITOR = uvm_visitor#(STRUCTURE)と宣言している。STRUCTUREを上書きすれば既定値もそれに従うはずだが（1800-2023の6.20.1）、VerilatorはVISITORを、STRUCTUREの既定から作ったuvm_visitor#(uvm_component)として型付けする。VISITORを明示した同じtraversalは一致する。UVMを使わない再現例は、Verilatorがそのまま拒否する。同じ依存する既定値の、別の症状である。
